body.name: Full blocked covariance model
body.construction: For \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), let \(b_{E_0}=\sum_{j\in V}|\Pi^{E_0}_j|\), \(\Theta_{E_0}=\mathbb R^{b_{E_0}}\times(0,\infty)^p\), and \[\mathcal M(E_0)=\left\{(I_p-B_{E_0}(\beta_{E_0}))^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(\omega_{E_0})(I_p-B_{E_0}(\beta_{E_0}))^{-\mathsf T}:(\beta_{E_0},\omega_{E_0})\in\Theta_{E_0}\right\}.\] The entry \((B_{E_0}(\beta_{E_0}))_{ji}\) equals \(\beta_{jB}\) for \(i\in B\in\Pi^{E_0}_j\), and all real block coefficients are admitted.
